# BDSMBRAZIL

## Introduction
BDSMBRAZIL is the premier BDSM portal in Brazil. It is a directory and platform dedicated to connecting users with verified professionals and providing a safe, consensual environment.

## Overview
This platform allows users to browse verified professional profiles, find information about the community, and manage their own profiles securely.

## Main Sections
- / : Homepage with the latest updates and featured profiles.
- /explorar : Directory to explore and find professionals by location or specialty.
- /perfis : Comprehensive list of professional profiles.
- /premium : Premium features and subscription plans for enhanced visibility.
- /sobre : Information about the platform, its mission, and its values.
- /contato : Contact page for support and inquiries.
- /faq : Frequently Asked Questions about the platform and its services.
- /como-funciona : Guide on how the platform works.
- /para-profissionais : Information dedicated to professionals joining the platform.

## Values
Safety, consent, and respect are the core principles of BDSMBRAZIL. The platform strongly emphasizes verification to ensure authenticity and a secure environment for all users.
